# Faqir Manifest Schema Reference

The machine-readable contract shipped beside every Faqir component and theme. A file validates as either a component manifest (`<name>.manifest.json`) or a theme manifest (`<name>.theme.json`). The PROTOCOL it describes is FROZEN at 1.0: until 2.0 this schema may only gain optional fields and widened enums — no field is renamed, removed, or made required — which is why `schema_version` (1.1) moves while `protocol_version` (1.0) does not. See SPEC-1.0.md §6 and §8.

Everything below is read out of `manifest.schema.json` — `schema_version` 1.1, `stability` frozen, published at `https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Narcis13/faqir-ui/main/manifest.schema.json`, amendment policy `https://github.com/Narcis13/faqir-ui/blob/v1.0.0/SPEC-1.0.md#8-stability-and-the-amendment-process`. Field names, types, descriptions and enums are the schema's own, so this file cannot drift from the contract it documents.

A component manifest sits beside its HTML and CSS at `registry/<primitives|recipes|patterns>/<name>/<name>.manifest.json`; a theme manifest is `registry/themes/<name>.theme.json`. Every manifest carries a `$schema` — a path relative to its own directory, so it resolves at any depth. `faqir create` writes one, and `bun scripts/add-schema-refs.mjs --check` fails on any manifest whose value is missing or stale.

The document is a `oneOf`: a file validates as **either** a component manifest **or** a theme manifest, never both and never neither.

**Authoring one.** `faqir create <name> --kind <primitive|recipe|pattern>` scaffolds a manifest that already carries every required field and a resolvable `$schema`, and registers the component — start there and fill it in, rather than from a blank file. Writing one by hand means writing every field in the required table below: there is no field the validator infers for you, and `faqir inspect <component>` prints a shipped one to work from.

## Component Manifest

A primitive, recipe, pattern, or scaffold component manifest.

Shipped as `<name>.manifest.json`.

### Required — all 17

`required` names **every one of these 17 fields**. A manifest that omits any of them does not validate, however sensible the omission looks — an empty object (`{}`) or an empty array (`[]`) is how a component with nothing to say says it.

| Field | Type | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `name` | `string` | non-empty |
| `version` | `string` | non-empty |
| `kind` | `string` (enum) | one of `primitive`, `recipe`, `pattern`, `scaffold` |
| `category` | `category` | The component's shelf in the registry. A closed vocabulary — the same list CONTRIBUTING.md documents. `custom` is reserved for components scaffolded by `faqir create` outside the registry. · one of `actions`, `composite`, `custom`, `data-display`, `feedback`, `forms`, `layout`, `marketing`, `navigation`, `overlay`, `typography` |
| `description` | `string` | non-empty |
| `anatomy` | `anatomy` | — |
| `slots` | { `<key>`: `slot` } | — |
| `variants` | { `<key>`: `variant` } | — |
| `states` | { `<key>`: `object` } | — |
| `a11y` | `object` | — |
| `tokens_used` | `string`[] | — |
| `templates` | `templates` | Named HTML templates. Most components ship an `html` template; some ship only variant-specific templates (`html_group`, `html_single`, …). Every value is an HTML string. · at least 1 entry |
| `safe_transforms` | `string`[] | — |
| `unsafe_transforms` | `string`[] | — |
| `composition` | `composition` | — |
| `files` | `files` | — |
| `tests` | `string`[] | — |

### Optional — 5

| Field | Type | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `$schema` | `string` | — |
| `aliases` | `string`[] | items non-empty |
| `changes` | `change`[] | — |
| `props` | { `<key>`: `prop` } | Attributes that are not variant groups: booleans, free-form strings and numbers read by a controller or by CSS. Consumed by the bindings codegen (framework props + defaults) and by the generated agent surfaces. |
| `api` | `object` | The controller's public surface — the methods `$ui` resolves to, and the object a recipe factory returns. GENERATED from the controller's own `// @ui:provides` line and its function declarations by `scripts/build-manifest-api.mjs`; never authored by hand, and checked for drift in CI. Present only on a component that ships a controller. Optional, which SPEC-1.0 §8 classifies as an additive amendment. |

## Theme Manifest

A theme descriptor shipped as `<name>.theme.json` beside `<name>.css`. The nine required fields are schema 1.0's; the five optional ones are schema 1.1's. Two of the optional pair — `axes` and `distinctiveness` — are DERIVED from the stylesheet by a generator rather than written by hand, which is the rule `tokens_overridden` and `tokens_inherited` have followed since 0.4.

Shipped as `<name>.theme.json`.

### Required — all 9

`required` names **every one of these 9 fields**. A manifest that omits any of them does not validate, however sensible the omission looks — an empty object (`{}`) or an empty array (`[]`) is how a component with nothing to say says it.

| Field | Type | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `name` | `string` | non-empty |
| `version` | `string` | non-empty |
| `mood` | `string`[] | at least 1 item · items non-empty |
| `scheme` | `string` (enum) | one of `light`, `dark`, `both` |
| `dark_mode` | `string` (enum) | one of `native`, `none` |
| `tokens_overridden` | `string`[] | at least 1 item · items non-empty |
| `tokens_inherited` | `string`[] | items non-empty |
| `pairs_with` | `string`[] | items non-empty |
| `preview` | `string` | non-empty |

### Optional — 6

| Field | Type | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `$schema` | `string` | — |
| `seed` | `themeSeed` | The generator input for a generated theme, written whole by `faqir theme generate` and absent on an authored theme (which has no seed). Every axis but `name` and `accent` is optional and states its own default, so `{ "name": …, "accent": … }` is a COMPLETE seed: the defaults together describe the shipped `default` theme's character, which is what makes an accent-only seed produce a theme rather than a fragment. The axis vocabulary is shared with `themeAxes` — the same fourteen axes, seen from the input side instead of the derived one. |
| `axes` | `themeAxes` | The fourteen axes a theme actually lands on, DERIVED from its CSS by `bun run gen:theme-manifests` (1.1A-08) and never hand-written — the same rule `tokens_overridden` and `tokens_inherited` have carried since 0.4. It is the seed's vocabulary minus `accent` and `document` (an authored theme has neither) plus `accent_hue` and `accent_chroma`, because a derived accent is two numbers rather than a colour string. Every axis is present: an incomplete `axes` block is the drift the field exists to catch. Agents pick a theme by these, not by the adjectives in `mood`. |
| `fonts` | `themeFont`[] | The self-hosted families this theme's role tokens name. Absent or empty on a theme that asks only for system faces. |
| `distinctiveness` | `themeDistinctiveness` | How far this theme sits from the nearest other shipped theme, written by the distinctiveness gate (1.1A-12) and never by hand. It exists because 1.0 shipped twelve themes that read as one: the gate refuses a generated theme that is too close to an existing one, and this block records the measurement it refused or allowed on. |
| `visual_matrix` | `boolean` | Whether this theme enters the full screenshot and axe matrix. ABSENT MEANS TRUE: a theme opts out explicitly with `false`, so a new theme is covered by default and a skipped one carries the reason in its own file (1.1A-13). |

### `themeSeed`

The generator input for a generated theme, written whole by `faqir theme generate` and absent on an authored theme (which has no seed). Every axis but `name` and `accent` is optional and states its own default, so `{ "name": …, "accent": … }` is a COMPLETE seed: the defaults together describe the shipped `default` theme's character, which is what makes an accent-only seed produce a theme rather than a fragment. The axis vocabulary is shared with `themeAxes` — the same fourteen axes, seen from the input side instead of the derived one.

| Field | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | `string` | yes | The theme's name — the same string as the manifest's `name`. It is carried here too because the seed is also written standalone as `<name>.seed.json`, which has to be re-runnable on its own. · non-empty |
| `accent` | `string` | yes | Axis `accent` — the hue and chroma the primary ramp, the ring, the gradient accent and the chart palette are built from. One of the three forms the colour parser accepts: `oklch(L C H)`, a hex triplet, or `white`/`black`. The only axis with no default: a seed without an accent is not a theme. · non-empty |
| `neutral` | `string` (enum) | no | Axis `neutral` — the bg / fg / border ramps' cast — `tinted` mixes the accent into the neutrals. Default `gray`. · one of `gray`, `cool`, `warm`, `tinted` |
| `scheme` | `string` (enum) | no | Axis `scheme` — which scheme blocks the theme ships, the same vocabulary as the manifest's own `scheme`. Default `both`. · one of `light`, `dark`, `both` |
| `type` | `themeAxisType` | no | Axis `type` — the three type decisions a theme makes: which families it pairs, how big and how far apart the ramp steps are, and how headings are voiced. Drives `--font-heading`, `--font-body`, `--font-ui`, the `--text-*` ramp and the `--heading-*` family. |
| `shape` | `themeAxisShape` | no | Axis `shape` — the silhouette. Drives the `--radius-*` ramp, the `--border-width-*` family and `--corner-shape`. |
| `depth` | `string` (enum) | no | Axis `depth` — the `--shadow-*` ramp, `--shadow-color` and `--surface-backdrop`. Default `soft`. · one of `flat`, `soft`, `layered`, `hard`, `glass`, `inset` |
| `material` | `string` (enum) | no | Axis `material` — which named texture `--texture-page` and `--texture-surface` point at. Default `none`. · one of `none`, `grain`, `paper`, `dots`, `grid`, `stripes`, `mesh` |
| `motion` | `string` (enum) | no | Axis `motion` — the `--duration-*` and `--ease-*` families (including the `linear()` springs) and `--motion-hover-lift`. Default `smooth`. · one of `none`, `minimal`, `smooth`, `snappy`, `springy`, `playful` |
| `density` | `string` (enum) | no | Axis `density` — the root default for the `data-density` modifier. Default `comfortable`. · one of `compact`, `comfortable`, `spacious` |
| `focus` | `string` (enum) | no | Axis `focus` — the `--focus-ring-*` family and `--focus-shadow`. Default `ring`. · one of `ring`, `glow`, `inset`, `bold` |
| `decoration` | `themeAxisDecoration` | no | Axis `decoration` — the small marks a theme makes on text and between things. Drives `--link-decoration`, `--link-underline-offset`, `--link-underline-thickness` and `--divider-style`. |
| `controls` | `themeAxisControls` | no | Axis `controls` — the silhouette of the four controls a theme is recognised by. Drives the component aliases in `registry/tokens/aliases.css` (`--button-radius`, `--input-fill`, `--checkbox-radius`, `--switch-radius`, …), never a component's own stylesheet. |
| `contrast` | `string` (enum) | no | Axis `contrast` — how far the ramps are pushed apart — `high` is the mechanism the hand-written `contrast` theme spelled out by hand. Default `standard`. · one of `standard`, `high` |
| `document` | `boolean` | no | Axis `document` — whether the seed also emits the paged `<name>-document` theme beside the screen one. Default `false`. |

### `themeAxes`

The fourteen axes a theme actually lands on, DERIVED from its CSS by `bun run gen:theme-manifests` (1.1A-08) and never hand-written — the same rule `tokens_overridden` and `tokens_inherited` have carried since 0.4. It is the seed's vocabulary minus `accent` and `document` (an authored theme has neither) plus `accent_hue` and `accent_chroma`, because a derived accent is two numbers rather than a colour string. Every axis is present: an incomplete `axes` block is the drift the field exists to catch. Agents pick a theme by these, not by the adjectives in `mood`.

| Field | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `accent_hue` | `number` | yes | Axis `accent`, first half: the accent's OKLCH hue in degrees, read off the generated ramp. Paired with `accent_chroma` it replaces the seed's free-form `accent` string with two numbers a distance metric can subtract (1.1A-12). |
| `accent_chroma` | `number` | yes | Axis `accent`, second half: the accent's OKLCH chroma. 0 is a neutral theme with no accent colour at all. |
| `neutral` | `string` (enum) | yes | Axis `neutral`, read back out of the theme's CSS — the bg / fg / border ramps' cast — `tinted` mixes the accent into the neutrals. · one of `gray`, `cool`, `warm`, `tinted` |
| `scheme` | `string` (enum) | yes | Axis `scheme`, read back out of the theme's CSS — which scheme blocks the theme ships, the same vocabulary as the manifest's own `scheme`. · one of `light`, `dark`, `both` |
| `type` | `themeAxisType` | yes | Axis `type` — the three type decisions a theme makes: which families it pairs, how big and how far apart the ramp steps are, and how headings are voiced. Drives `--font-heading`, `--font-body`, `--font-ui`, the `--text-*` ramp and the `--heading-*` family. |
| `shape` | `themeAxisShape` | yes | Axis `shape` — the silhouette. Drives the `--radius-*` ramp, the `--border-width-*` family and `--corner-shape`. |
| `depth` | `string` (enum) | yes | Axis `depth`, read back out of the theme's CSS — the `--shadow-*` ramp, `--shadow-color` and `--surface-backdrop`. · one of `flat`, `soft`, `layered`, `hard`, `glass`, `inset` |
| `material` | `string` (enum) | yes | Axis `material`, read back out of the theme's CSS — which named texture `--texture-page` and `--texture-surface` point at. · one of `none`, `grain`, `paper`, `dots`, `grid`, `stripes`, `mesh` |
| `motion` | `string` (enum) | yes | Axis `motion`, read back out of the theme's CSS — the `--duration-*` and `--ease-*` families (including the `linear()` springs) and `--motion-hover-lift`. · one of `none`, `minimal`, `smooth`, `snappy`, `springy`, `playful` |
| `density` | `string` (enum) | yes | Axis `density`, read back out of the theme's CSS — the root default for the `data-density` modifier. · one of `compact`, `comfortable`, `spacious` |
| `focus` | `string` (enum) | yes | Axis `focus`, read back out of the theme's CSS — the `--focus-ring-*` family and `--focus-shadow`. · one of `ring`, `glow`, `inset`, `bold` |
| `decoration` | `themeAxisDecoration` | yes | Axis `decoration` — the small marks a theme makes on text and between things. Drives `--link-decoration`, `--link-underline-offset`, `--link-underline-thickness` and `--divider-style`. |
| `controls` | `themeAxisControls` | yes | Axis `controls` — the silhouette of the four controls a theme is recognised by. Drives the component aliases in `registry/tokens/aliases.css` (`--button-radius`, `--input-fill`, `--checkbox-radius`, `--switch-radius`, …), never a component's own stylesheet. |
| `contrast` | `string` (enum) | yes | Axis `contrast`, read back out of the theme's CSS — how far the ramps are pushed apart — `high` is the mechanism the hand-written `contrast` theme spelled out by hand. · one of `standard`, `high` |

### `themeAxisVoice`

Axis `type.voice` — how headings are set, independently of which family sets them. Drives `--heading-weight`, `--heading-tracking` and `--heading-transform`.

| Field | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `weight` | `string` (enum) | no | Heading weight, resolved against the `--weight-*` ramp. Default `bold`. · one of `regular`, `medium`, `semibold`, `bold`, `black` |
| `tracking` | `string` (enum) | no | Heading letter-spacing, added to a heading's own optical tightening. Default `normal`. · one of `tight`, `normal`, `wide` |
| `transform` | `string` (enum) | no | Heading `text-transform`. Default `none`. · one of `none`, `uppercase`, `small-caps` |

### `themeAxisType`

Axis `type` — the three type decisions a theme makes: which families it pairs, how big and how far apart the ramp steps are, and how headings are voiced. Drives `--font-heading`, `--font-body`, `--font-ui`, the `--text-*` ramp and the `--heading-*` family.

| Field | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `pairing` | `string` (enum) | no | Which families the role tokens name. `custom` means the theme states `--font-heading` and `--font-body` itself; every other value is a catalogue pairing the generator knows how to install (1.1A-18). Default `system`. · one of `system`, `sans-humanist`, `sans-grotesque`, `sans-geometric`, `rounded`, `serif-editorial`, `serif-modern`, `slab`, `mono`, `custom` |
| `scale` | `number` (enum) | no | The ratio between adjacent `--text-*` steps. Default `1.2`. · one of `1.125`, `1.2`, `1.25`, `1.333` |
| `base` | `integer` (enum) | no | `--text-base` in CSS pixels; every other step is computed from it and the scale. Default `16`. · one of `15`, `16`, `17`, `18` |
| `voice` | `themeAxisVoice` | no | Axis `type.voice` — how headings are set, independently of which family sets them. Drives `--heading-weight`, `--heading-tracking` and `--heading-transform`. |

### `themeAxisShape`

Axis `shape` — the silhouette. Drives the `--radius-*` ramp, the `--border-width-*` family and `--corner-shape`.

| Field | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `radius` | `string` (enum) | no | How round a corner is: `sharp` is 0, `pill` is `--radius-full`, and the three between walk the `--radius-*` ramp. Default `soft`. · one of `sharp`, `crisp`, `soft`, `round`, `pill` |
| `border` | `string` (enum) | no | How heavy an edge is: `hairline` is `--border-width-sm` (today's 1px default), `regular` `-md`, `heavy` `-lg`. Default `hairline`. · one of `hairline`, `regular`, `heavy` |
| `corner` | `string` (enum) | no | `--corner-shape` — progressive, so a browser without `corner-shape` renders `round` whatever the theme asks for. Default `round`. · one of `round`, `bevel`, `scoop`, `notch` |

### `themeAxisDecoration`

Axis `decoration` — the small marks a theme makes on text and between things. Drives `--link-decoration`, `--link-underline-offset`, `--link-underline-thickness` and `--divider-style`.

| Field | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `link` | `string` (enum) | no | How a link is underlined. `none` silences every underline in the registry at once, `offset` is today's underline with `--link-underline-offset`, `thick` leans on `--link-underline-thickness`. Default `offset`. · one of `none`, `plain`, `offset`, `thick` |
| `divider` | `string` (enum) | no | `--divider-style` — the line style a separator, a divided list and a table rule draw with. Default `solid`. · one of `solid`, `dashed`, `dotted`, `double` |

### `themeAxisControls`

Axis `controls` — the silhouette of the four controls a theme is recognised by. Drives the component aliases in `registry/tokens/aliases.css` (`--button-radius`, `--input-fill`, `--checkbox-radius`, `--switch-radius`, …), never a component's own stylesheet.

| Field | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `button` | `string` (enum) | no | Button silhouette. Default `soft`. · one of `rect`, `pill`, `soft` |
| `input` | `string` (enum) | no | Text-control silhouette: a bordered `box`, a `filled` plate (`--input-fill`), or a single `underline` rule. Default `box`. · one of `box`, `filled`, `underline` |
| `checkbox` | `string` (enum) | no | Checkbox corner: `square` is `--checkbox-radius`, `round` is a circle. Default `square`. · one of `square`, `round` |
| `switch` | `string` (enum) | no | Switch track and thumb corner. Default `pill`. · one of `pill`, `square` |

### `themeFont`

One self-hosted family a theme's role tokens name, installed by `faqir fonts add` (1.1A-18). Declared here so a project can see what a theme will download before it applies it, and so the licence travels with the theme rather than with the download.

| Field | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `family` | `string` | yes | The family name as `font-family` spells it, e.g. `Fraunces`. · non-empty |
| `license` | `string` | yes | The licence the family ships under, e.g. `OFL-1.1`. Faqir installs open-licensed families only; the string is what a project's own licence audit reads. · non-empty |
| `role` | `string` (enum) | yes | Which role token names the family. · one of `heading`, `body`, `ui`, `mono` |
| `source` | `string` | no | Where the files came from — a catalogue id or a URL. Optional: a family already on the machine has no source. · non-empty |

### `themeDistinctiveness`

How far this theme sits from the nearest other shipped theme, written by the distinctiveness gate (1.1A-12) and never by hand. It exists because 1.0 shipped twelve themes that read as one: the gate refuses a generated theme that is too close to an existing one, and this block records the measurement it refused or allowed on.

| Field | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `nearest` | `string` | yes | The name of the closest other shipped theme. · non-empty |
| `axis_distance` | `integer` | yes | How many of the fourteen axes the two themes differ on. Two shipped themes must differ on at least four (FAQIR-VISION §5.2). |
| `token_distance` | `number` | yes | Mean OKLab ΔE between the two themes' resolved colour tokens, over every scheme they both ship. The axis count says they are described differently; this says they LOOK different. The gate's floor is the same separation the framework demands between two adjacent surfaces inside one theme. |

## File Set Per Kind

`files` requires `html`, `css` and `manifest` whatever the kind — `js` is declared by the components that ship a controller, and only those. Counted across the 86 manifests in `registry/`:

| `kind` | Components | Declare `files.js` |
|---|---|---|
| `pattern` | 15 | 0 |
| `primitive` | 42 | 0 |
| `recipe` | 29 | 29 |

## Schema Changelog

The schema carries its own history. `1.0` is frozen: until `2.0` it may only gain optional fields and widen enums.

| Version | Task | Breaking | Note |
|---|---|---|---|
| `0.5` | `0.5-07` | no | First published as a file: component and theme manifests in one document, `changes[]` changelog entries, an `$id`, and a resolvable `$schema` on every registry manifest. Before this the contract existed only as the validator in `src/manifest.ts`. |
| `0.8` | `0.8-02` | yes | `props` — the non-variant attributes — declared; `variants.<group>.responsive` added for the tier suffix grammar; `category` closed to a documented enum, which retired the `form` spelling in favour of `forms`. |
| `1.0` | `1.0-01` | no | Frozen. `schema_version` is `1.0`, `stability` and `amendment_policy` are declared in the file, this changelog is carried in it, and the schema is published at a versioned URL beside the spec. No field changed shape. |
| `1.0` | `W2-4` | no | `api` — a component's controller surface, generated from the controller's `@ui:provides` annotation. Optional, so every 1.0 manifest still validates; additive under SPEC-1.0 §8. It exists because the data was already in every controller and on no surface an agent reads: `faqir explain <recipe> --json` returned no `api` for any of the 29 JS-backed recipes. |
| `1.1` | `1.1A-07` | no | Five optional theme-manifest fields: `seed` (the generator input, absent on an authored theme), `axes` (the fourteen axes derived from the CSS, never hand-written), `fonts`, `distinctiveness` and `visual_matrix`. Optional, so every manifest written against 1.0 still validates; additive under SPEC-1.0 §8, which is why the protocol stays frozen at 1.0 while the schema moves to 1.1. The seed's vocabulary is stated in full — every axis, every enum, every default — because it is the generator's input contract, not a hint. |

## Worked Example — `registry/primitives/button/button.manifest.json`

The shipped `button` manifest, verbatim. Not an illustration of one: this is the file in the registry, so every field it shows is a field that validates today.

```json
{
  "$schema": "../../../manifest.schema.json",
  "name": "button",
  "version": "1.1.0",
  "kind": "primitive",
  "category": "actions",
  "description": "Interactive button with multiple visual variants and sizes",

  "changes": [
    {
      "version": "1.1.0",
      "note": "data-full is now declared (it was in button.css and in no manifest, so the docs site, the skill, faqir context and the vue/react bindings did not know it existed). It is a boolean prop rather than a variant or a state, by the reasoning stack's data-wrap settled in 0.8-03: it is authored, static, and valueless presence. No CSS or behaviour change. 0.8-10's undeclared-attribute rule now makes this class of drift impossible: an attribute a component's CSS selects on that its manifest never declares fails the registry gate.",
      "breaking": false
    }
  ],

  "anatomy": {
    "tag": "button",
    "selector": "[data-ui='button']",
    "content_model": "inline"
  },

  "slots": {
    "icon": {
      "selector": "[data-part='icon']",
      "required": false,
      "tag_hint": "span",
      "description": "Optional leading icon container"
    }
  },

  "variants": {
    "visual": {
      "values": ["default", "primary", "secondary", "destructive", "ghost", "outline", "link"],
      "default": "default",
      "attr": "data-variant",
      "applied_to": "root"
    },
    "size": {
      "values": ["sm", "md", "lg"],
      "default": "md",
      "attr": "data-size",
      "applied_to": "root"
    }
  },

  "states": {
    "default": { "attr": "data-state=\"default\"", "default": true },
    "loading": { "attr": "data-state=\"loading\"" },
    "disabled": { "attr": "disabled" }
  },

  "props": {
    "caption": { "type": "string", "default": "Click me", "description": "Button label text" },
    "icon": { "type": "string", "default": "", "description": "Icon content for the icon slot" },
    "disabled": { "type": "boolean", "default": false, "description": "Whether the button is disabled" },
    "full": { "type": "boolean", "default": false, "attr": "data-full", "description": "Stretch the button to the full inline size of its container (display: flex; width: 100%)" }
  },

  "a11y": {
    "required_attrs": ["aria-label required when icon-only (no text content)"],
    "keyboard": {
      "Enter": "activate",
      "Space": "activate"
    }
  },

  "tokens_used": [
    "color-primary", "color-primary-hover", "color-primary-fg",
    "color-secondary", "color-secondary-hover", "color-secondary-fg",
    "color-destructive", "color-destructive-hover", "color-destructive-fg",
    "color-bg", "color-bg-muted", "color-bg-subtle", "color-fg", "color-border", "color-ring",
    "radius-md", "radius-full",
    "space-2", "space-3", "space-4", "space-6",
    "font-ui", "text-xs", "text-sm", "text-base", "weight-medium",
    "duration-fast", "ease-default",
    "border-width", "border-width-strong", "corner-shape", "focus-ring-width", "focus-ring-offset", "focus-ring-style", "focus-ring-color", "focus-shadow", "button-text-transform", "motion-hover-lift", "link-decoration", "disabled-opacity"
  ],

  "templates": {
    "html": "<button data-ui=\"button\" data-variant=\"{variant}\" data-size=\"{size}\">{text}</button>",
    "html_with_icon": "<button data-ui=\"button\" data-variant=\"{variant}\" data-size=\"{size}\"><span data-part=\"icon\">{icon}</span>{text}</button>",
    "html_icon_only": "<button data-ui=\"button\" data-variant=\"{variant}\" data-size=\"{size}\" aria-label=\"{label}\">{icon}</button>"
  },

  "safe_transforms": [
    "change-variant",
    "change-size",
    "add-icon",
    "add-loading-state",
    "wrap-in-button-group",
    "change-text-content"
  ],

  "unsafe_transforms": [
    "remove-button-element",
    "change-to-div-without-role",
    "remove-disabled-state-handling"
  ],

  "composition": {
    "contains": [],
    "used_in": ["card", "dialog", "auth-form", "crud-table"]
  },

  "files": {
    "html": "button.html",
    "css": "button.css",
    "manifest": "button.manifest.json"
  },

  "tests": [
    "renders-as-button-element",
    "default-variant-has-no-data-variant-attr",
    "primary-variant-sets-data-variant-primary",
    "sm-size-sets-data-size-sm",
    "disabled-state-has-disabled-attribute",
    "loading-state-sets-data-state-loading",
    "icon-only-requires-aria-label"
  ]
}
```

## Machine Comments

The manifest is the contract; the sources repeat the machine-readable part of it in their header comments, which `faqir audit` and the registry gate parse. From `button`:

```html
<!-- @ui:component button -->
<!-- @ui:kind primitive -->
<!-- @ui:slots icon -->
<!-- @ui:variants visual=default|primary|secondary|destructive|ghost|outline|link size=sm|md|lg -->
```

```css
/* @ui:component button */
/* @ui:tokens color-primary color-primary-hover color-primary-fg color-secondary color-secondary-hover color-secondary-fg color-destructive color-destructive-hover color-destructive-fg color-bg color-bg-muted color-bg-subtle color-fg color-border color-ring radius-md space-2 space-3 space-4 space-6 font-ui text-xs text-sm text-base weight-medium duration-fast ease-default shadow-xs radius-full border-width border-width-strong corner-shape focus-ring-width focus-ring-offset focus-ring-style focus-ring-color focus-shadow button-text-transform motion-hover-lift link-decoration disabled-opacity */
```
